name: Shibayama (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shibayama town emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing a stylised letter W.
history: Municipal flag of Shibayama, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 February 1966.

features.role: Shibayama town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised letter W
